bullets: Christians across Nigeria — thousands killed, over 200 churches destroyed, pastors abducted and murdered, communities displaced by relentless militant violence
House church believers, detained pastors, and their families in China facing torture, fabricated charges, medical neglect, passport confiscation, and years of imprisonment
Jehovah's Witness believers in Russia sentenced to six and seven years in prison for Bible study and peaceful online religious discussion
Around 20 Christian families in Iran evicted from their historic place of worship after government seizure of the country's oldest Protestant church
Two young female converts in Uganda left homeless and endangered after a family member burned their home following their baptism
Christian pastor killed by military forces in Myanmar amid an escalating pattern of clergy killings and church destruction
Pastor in Cuba freed after three months of incommunicado detention and reported abuse, still facing criminal charges with no resolution
Twelve believers in Algeria arrested during worship at a humanitarian shelter, facing imprisonment under anti-Christian ordinances
Women believers in India beaten and abducted during Sunday worship amid rising communal violence and legal challenges to anti-conversion laws
Christian congregation in Syria shaken after a bomb detonated near their cathedral on a major holy feast day
Sudanese Christian convert and her six children living under ongoing threats in a South Sudan refugee camp after fleeing persecution
Historic church building in the United Kingdom destroyed by fire amid a growing pattern of similar incidents across the country

Over 3.6 million internally displaced people across Myanmar, including tens of thousands in Rakhine State, caught in multi-front airstrikes, naval bombardment, and ground offensives with no safe refuge.
More than 15 million Sudanese displaced by civil war — nearly 20 million facing acute hunger, drone strikes on civilian areas, and an aid system on the verge of total collapse.
Yemeni civilians — over 125,000 displaced, including 57,000 children — fleeing rapid coastal advances, Houthi seizure of key ports and islands, and ongoing aerial attacks on Saudi territory.
Tens of thousands of Palestinian civilians in Gaza amid ongoing airstrikes, over 8,000 people still missing under rubble, and worsening humanitarian conditions.

Millions of Nigerians across the northeast, northwest, and south affected by Boko Haram abductions, mass kidnappings, armed raids, detention deaths, and children unable to attend school due to insecurity.
Somali civilians living amid sustained al-Shabaab infiltration, ongoing airstrikes in southern regions, and over 14,000 people uprooted by fighting near Baidoa.
Iranian religious minorities, protesters, and their families — including children killed in crackdowns, thousands imprisoned, and Baha'i communities facing raids, sentences, and property seizure.
Congolese civilians in eastern communities killed by explosive remnants of war, dozens held by rebel kidnappers in Ituri, and urban protesters clashing with authorities over constitutional changes.
Civilians and maritime crews in the Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea — 22 seafarers killed and dozens more at risk amid sustained attacks on international shipping.
Ukrainians and Russians caught in escalating mutual drone and missile strikes on energy infrastructure, civilian shipping in the Black Sea, and population centers as winter approaches.
Residents of Nigerian communities in Zamfara, Borno, Adamawa, and Oyo states facing armed raids, kidnappings of religious leaders, and families grieving 37 people who died in state custody.
Fifteen villagers killed in an overnight raid in Far North Cameroon, and surviving community members living in fear of further attacks.
Syrian civilians across multiple provinces facing fuel shortages, hyperinflation, ethnic tensions, a fatal prison fire, and IS-linked ambushes under a fragile post-conflict government.
Civilians in Pakistan's northwest mourning at least 16 killed — including police officers — in a mosque bombing during Friday prayers.
Malian soldiers and their families after a militant attack on a military camp killed at least 50 soldiers and allied paramilitaries.
Residents of Burkina Faso's eastern region caught in ongoing armed group attacks resulting in scores of casualties.
Over 610,000 migrants detained in the United States — including more than 6,200 children separated from families — facing uncertain legal status and prolonged detention.
Colombian children forcibly recruited into armed groups, caught between guerrilla camps and military airstrikes in jungle regions.
Civilians across Mexican states living under cartel violence — including families of thousands killed in Sinaloa and communities where Independence Day celebrations were cancelled due to shootouts.
Students, families, and a school community in the southern Philippines grieving two teenagers killed and others wounded in a school shooting.
Residents of Saudi Arabia's southern cities — including women and children — wounded by drone and missile strikes on civilian areas and energy infrastructure.
Nine women killed over two months in a South African municipality, with families and communities living in fear of further gender-based violence.
Hundreds of Somali soldiers detained in Ethiopia, separated from families, with the futures of thousands of recruits left uncertain.
Residents of French communities confronting an alleged far-right terror plot linked to a serving law enforcement officer.
Tourists and residents of Croatia's coastal island communities displaced and injured by wind-driven wildfires threatening homes and livelihoods.

Families across the United States facing wildfire destruction in Oklahoma, flash flooding in the Northeast, fatal floodwaters on Navajo Nation lands, and seismic activity in remote Alaskan communities.
Over 160 residents in India's northeastern highlands evacuated due to recurring landslides and flooding, including elderly people and children sheltering in relief camps.
Communities across the Philippines in flood-affected areas facing a deadly surge of leptospirosis with hundreds of fatalities recorded.
Families and children in Vietnam displaced by rising floodwaters along a swollen river amid widespread seasonal rainfall.
Health workers and vulnerable communities across the Democratic Republic of Congo battling a widening Ebola outbreak spanning multiple provinces amid insecurity and scarce medical resources.
Approximately 17,000 children in Nepal in urgent need of mental health support following devastating glacier-triggered floods that damaged roads, homes, and critical infrastructure.
Farming and pastoral communities across drought-affected regions of Russia facing deteriorating soil conditions and threats to livelihoods.
Residents of seismically active communities in Timor-Leste, Indonesia, Solomon Islands, Japan, Mexico, and Papua New Guinea living with ongoing earthquake risk and uncertainty.
